description: Render PlantUML source text to an SVG, a PNG image or an Excalidraw JSON document. Only the first @start...@end block (or the given page of a newpage document) is rendered. Parse warnings are returned as diagnostics. The input is text only; files and URLs are not read.

clean.description: Use clean strokes instead of the hand-drawn look.

page.description: Page of a newpage document, starting at 0.

seed.description: Seed for the stroke wobble and element ids. Same input and seed give identical output.

width.description: PNG width in pixels. Ignored for other formats.

name: render_plantuml

bytes.description: Size of the rendered output in bytes.

pages.description: Number of pages in the diagram block.

title: Render PlantUML
